scope: Existing Venice C pilot: eight representative asset prototypes and one background; not a complete scene inventory.

items.name: 粉色民居
items.identity_brief: A narrow salmon-pink Venetian house with a terra-cotta gable roof, arched green door, a few arched windows and simple attached flowerboxes.

items.name: 钟楼
items.identity_brief: A slender salmon-colored Venetian bell tower with a teal pyramidal spire, cream belfry framing, a bronze bell and a simple stone base.

items.name: 空贡多拉
items.identity_brief: One empty Venetian gondola with a curved blue hull, restrained gold-colored rim, red seat and wood interior. Remove its living rider and handheld oar.

items.name: 空水上巴士
items.identity_brief: One empty Venetian waterbus with a rounded cream canopy, open-sided cabin, simple seats, cream sides and a blue hull with a red stripe. Remove passengers.

items.name: 鹅雕像喷泉
items.identity_brief: A circular cream stone fountain with contained turquoise water and a central goose sculpture on a pedestal; the sculpture belongs to the fountain. Exclude surrounding planters.

items.name: 单头路灯
items.identity_brief: One upright slender teal-blue Venetian street lamp with a single warm yellow lantern and a complete simple base.

items.name: 面具鹅
items.identity_brief: One cream-white goose in a red-and-gold Venetian carnival mask and costume, orange beak and webbed feet. Keep its mask identity while simplifying the outfit.

items.name: 船夫鹅
items.identity_brief: One goose gondolier with a straw boater hat and red band, navy-and-white striped shirt, red neckerchief, orange beak and webbed feet. Complete the body hidden by its boat.

items.name: 空背景
items.identity_brief: The Venice canal network, pale stone paved quays, stone embankments and four fixed arch bridges. Remove all independent buildings, boats, characters, movable facilities and vegetation.
